content: actions/create-github-app-token@v3 mints a GitHub App installation access token in-workflow; use owner+repositories inputs to scope it to a different repository, and give the App Contents: read and write. Token is short-lived (1h) and not tied to a human account, so it does not expire like a PAT. Alternative: a per-repository deploy key with write access (SSH, repo-scoped, no account coupling). peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8 is current for the PR-instead-of-direct-push pattern.
